title: S1 V3.9 and trend cleanliness — cleaner trends lean better, including clean down-trends, but nothing separates and a cleanliness filter gives up more profit than it saves
question: Does S1 V3.9 do better when the trend into the entry is clean (high efficiency ratio), and would trading S1 only in clean trends have helped?
hypothesis: Trader's view: January 2026 went well because the trend was clean; S1 should return when price action is clean again.

findings.title: The cleanest third of entries did a little better, inside the bound
findings.detail: ER20 terciles (cuts [0.1331, 0.3089]): high mean +0.4697R, win 57.26% (n=117); mid +0.2416R (n=114); low +0.3442R (n=115). High minus low +0.1256R against a bound of 0.5616R. Not monotonic: the middle third was worst.
findings.title_zh: 走勢最乾淨的三分之一稍微好一點，但在門檻內

findings.title: Clean down-trends were as good as clean up-trends
findings.detail: Up-clean +0.4641R (n=126), down-clean +0.4281R (n=47), choppy +0.2513R (n=173). Up-clean vs choppy +0.2128R, bound 0.5009. If anything it is cleanliness, not direction; still unproven.
findings.title_zh: 乾淨的下跌和乾淨的上漲一樣好
findings.detail_zh: 乾淨上漲 +0.4641R（n=126）、乾淨下跌 +0.4281R（n=47）、震盪 +0.2513R（n=173）。乾淨上漲比震盪多 +0.2128R，門檻 0.5009。如果有差，是「乾不乾淨」而不是方向；但仍未證實。

findings.title: By month, the weekly measure tracks S1 better than the daily one
findings.detail: Rank correlation of S1 monthly net R with the month's mean ER: 13-week 0.461, 20-day 0.081 (n=22 months; a rank correlation needs about ±0.61 to clear 2.8/√(n−1)). January 2026: +18.54R, ER20 0.364, ER13w 0.35. The three weakest recent months (2026-08 to 10) had ER13w 0.30, 0.12, 0.11.
findings.title_zh: 以月來看，週線的乾淨度比日線更貼近 S1 的成績

findings.title: Trading S1 only in clean trends would have given up more profit than it kept
findings.detail: Top-tercile-only: kept 117 trades, +2704.32 USD; removed 229 trades that made +3298.17 USD. Per trade kept is better in both halves (+0.1871R, +0.1681R; bounds 0.6888, 0.6859), but the removed trades were still profitable.
findings.title_zh: 只在乾淨走勢做 S1，放棄的獲利比留下的還多
findings.detail_zh: 只做最乾淨三分之一：留下 117 筆、+2704.32 美元；拿掉的 229 筆其實賺了 +3298.17 美元。每筆平均在前後兩半都是留下的較好（+0.1871R、+0.1681R；門檻 0.6888、0.6859），但被拿掉的單仍然是賺的。

card_summary: Cleaner trends lean slightly better for S1 (clean down-trends too), nothing separates, and a cleanliness filter removes trades that still made money.
title_zh: S1 V3.9 與走勢乾淨度：越乾淨稍好、乾淨下跌也一樣，但分不出來；只做乾淨走勢會少賺
question_zh: 進場前走勢越乾淨（效率比越高），S1 是否越好？只在乾淨走勢做 S1，過去會不會比較好？
hypothesis_zh: 交易者的想法：今年 1 月做得好是因為走勢乾淨；走勢重新變乾淨時 S1 可以再進來。
card_summary_zh: 乾淨走勢 S1 稍好，乾淨下跌也一樣；但分不出來，而且只做乾淨走勢會砍掉仍在賺錢的單。
limitations_zh: 346 筆、22 個月，只有一份策略回測匯出（不是帳戶成交）。
三分組切點來自同一批交易，是描述，不是樣本外規則。
S1 只做多，乾淨下跌只有 47 筆。
interpretation_zh: 你的直覺方向是對的，但證據不夠當規則用。乾淨走勢每筆稍微好一點，前後兩段都一樣，而且乾淨的下跌也一樣好，所以重點是「乾不乾淨」不是漲跌。週線的乾淨度和每月成績的關係（0.46）比日線（0.08）明顯；最近三個月 13 週效率比掉到 0.1 左右，S1 也剛好持平到小虧。但把震盪期的 S1 全部關掉，會砍掉 229 筆合計仍然賺錢的單。比較合理的用法是：13 週效率比低的時候減量，而不是停掉；而這個用法要先登記再用之後的資料驗證。

presentation.title: S1 每月淨 R 與當月平均效率比
